correctness.rationale: Split so4 decomposes as sl2 plus sl2, with nonzero literal-square-zero operator in exactly one ideal; nonzero commuting traceless sl2 nilpotents lie on one line. Support partitions and inclusion-exclusion give the total, while reduced components are Segre-cone products indexed by subsets S. Nonsplit form has Witt index one; square-zero skew maps have even rank and totally isotropic image, so all vanish. Nonsplit Frobenius swaps the D2 factors and thus S with its complement. Independently enumerated sl2(nilpotent) lines and mixed support for q=3,5,7, giving 193,1441,5377 split pairs; proof is all odd prime powers and r>=2.
